nota: Sem número. As duas citações são opinião atribuída, e a voz as dá assim.
narracao: Willard's side called the railroad's Port Los Angeles a "monopoly harbor"; the one dissenter on a later board would write that spending at San Pedro "would probably eventuate in a serious monopoly." This video doesn't settle that. The board didn't either.
